# The engine's `idempotency-v1` route set (U-18): the operations its
# openapi.json marks `x-idempotency: true`, recorded from engine main
# 4dfedc47 (PR #171) and listed in its docs/DESKTOP.md "Request
# idempotency". Append-only for this capability name: routes added later
# get a new capability name. tests/spec_fixtures.rs checks that the
# `keyable` rows of operations.txt are exactly these, and that the pinned
# engine's openapi.json marks exactly these once it advertises them.

POST /api/v1/items
POST /api/v1/tags
POST /api/v1/templates

POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/occurrences/{date}/skip
